No price stop. A thesis review every quarter and after every results filing. Exit only on a recorded thesis break.
Swing 2.0.0 as written: EMA10 > EMA30 and close > the prior 20-session high; hold 3 sessions; entry window 1 session; stop 2×ATR14; target 2R; real tick size required
Year-over-year revenue and EPS growth > 0 from registered filings; close > SMA20; margin of safety ≥ 15% against the bear-case annual-EPS scenario; hold ≤ 63 sessions

Positive operating cash-flow margin in at least 4 of 5 years; net debt / operating cash flow ≤ 2; positive free cash flow; business and governance coverage required; bear/base/bull PE scenarios are display only
Always INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE before any directional decision. Verified adverse evidence leads to AVOID.
